findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "defi" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: crypto_price, fx_rate · Private data: hl_wallet_positions, polymarket_scanner, defi_chains_tvl, defi_protocol_tvl, defi_yields, dex_new_pools, perp_funding, evm_log_decode, contract_audit, base_verdict, tx_check, evm_token_info, evm_wallet_balance, evm_balances_bulk, evm_tx, crypto_price, fx_rate, gas_all, cross_chain_quote, token_exit_matrix, wallet_investigate · Public sink: dex_volumes, tx_check · Destructive: workflow_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: crypto_price, fx_rate · Private data: hl_wallet_positions, polymarket_scanner, defi_chains_tvl, defi_protocol_tvl, defi_yields, dex_new_pools, perp_funding, evm_log_decode, contract_audit, base_verdict, tx_check, evm_token_info, evm_wallet_balance, evm_balances_bulk, evm_tx, crypto_price, fx_rate, gas_all, cross_chain_quote, token_exit_matrix, wallet_investigate · Public sink: dex_volumes, tx_check · Destructive: workflow_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
